title: Yoast SEO Setup
description: Configure Yoast SEO for production — site representation, search appearance, sitemaps, and Search Console.

steps.title: Complete Yoast General Settings
steps.instructions: Run the Yoast configuration wizard or set site name, tagline, organization/person type, and logo under SEO → General.

steps.title: Configure Search Appearance
steps.instructions: Set title templates and meta descriptions for posts, pages, and custom post types. Define separator and breadcrumb settings.

steps.title: Set Social & Open Graph Defaults
steps.instructions: Add Facebook app ID if used, default OG image, and Twitter card settings under SEO → Social.

steps.title: Enable & Tune XML Sitemap
steps.instructions: Confirm the Yoast sitemap is enabled. Exclude thin pages, internal search, cart, and admin-only post types from the index.

steps.title: Verify Schema & Breadcrumbs
steps.instructions: Enable breadcrumbs if the theme supports them. Confirm Organization or Person schema matches legal business details.

steps.title: Set Noindex for Staging & Utility Pages
steps.instructions: Noindex tag archives, author archives if thin, and utility pages. Keep production indexable; keep staging discouraged or noindexed.

steps.title: Connect Google Search Console
steps.instructions: Link Search Console in Yoast integrations or Site Kit. Submit the sitemap and review coverage for crawl errors.
